verdict.rationale: Aleph's AI mapping agents follow user-written natural-language prompts that say what to look for. They watch source data 24/7, react when new accounts, vendors or dimensions appear, and send real-time Slack or Teams alerts with mapping suggestions for approval. That is a real event-driven automation, but it is limited to the mapping domain rather than a general rule engine. The 'reporting automation' and 'autopilot' claims are too vague to count as user-defined triggers. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule or trigger builder covering arbitrary events and actions, documentation of configurable trigger conditions and action types, automatic execution without manual approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: simple, natural-language prompts that train your agents on what to look for and how to structure suggestions
agents monitor your source data 24/7, ensuring new accounts, vendors, and dimensions are properly mapped
Get real-time Slack or Teams alerts to review and approve suggestions.
